concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun giderilmesi ve ic yatiskinligi onde oldugunda dogal karsiliktir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمن ضد الخوف (ayn;sihah)؛ أصل الأمن طمأنينة النفس وزوال الخوف (mufradat)؛ الأمانة ضد الخيانة ومعناها سكون القلب (maqayis)؛ الأمان إعطاء الأمنة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أمن فلان يأمن أمنا وأمانا وأمنة فهو آمن (tahdhib)؛ استأمن إليه دخل في أمانه (sihah)؛ مأمنه منزله الذي فيه أمنه (mufradat)؛ الأمون الناقة الأمينة الوثيقة أو التي يؤمن فتورها وعثورها (ayn;sihah;mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمن ضد الخوف، والأمان وإعطاء الأمنة، والأمانة ضد الخيانة وما اؤتمن عليه، والآمن والمأمن والاستئمان، والأمين والمأمون وما يوثق به، ومنه وثاقة الناقة الأمون.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تصديق الإيمان من حيث هو تصديق، ولا صيغة آمين في الدعاء، ولا أمن المركبة من أم ومن في قوله أمن هو قانت.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin mülküne veya yürüttüğü işe kazanç ya da getiri olarak giren maldır. Hesap ilişkisinde dışarı çıkan malın karşı kutbunu oluşturur.

Bu mali giriş, hesap düzeninde dışarı çıkan malın karşıtı olarak belirlenir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarihsel mülk veya işletme bağlamında mali girişin açıkça anlatılması gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Tek başına kullanıldığında gider karşıtlığını doğrudan belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Kazancın bir işe veya mülke girişini açıkça korur.

error_profile.collision: Henüz tahsil edilmemiş değer artışı veya genel başarıyla karışabilir.
error_profile.loses: Değerin mülke giren akış ve giderin karşıtı olma yönünü zayıflatır.
error_profile.preserves: Elde edilen mali değeri korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal parasal veya mal niteliğindeki girişi anlatır; genel içeri girme ile gizli kusur anlamlarını kapsamaz.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin mülküne veya işletmesine kazanç olarak giren şeyi ve bunun dışarı çıkan malın karşıtı oluşunu açıkça bildirir; hazırlanan mali giriş dalı bu iki unsuru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın mali giriş ve gelir anlamıyla sınırlıdır; kazancın özel elde edilme yollarını veya başka dalların kullanımlarını eklemez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: On yedi adayın tamamı karşılaştırıldı; gelir-gider karşıtını, kazanma eylemini ve ticari artışı ayıran üçü seçildi, fiyat, mal edinme ve genel geçim alanındaki daha uzak adaylar elendi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Paylaşılan mali akış ekseninde yönleri karşıttır; odak dal giriş, komşu dal çıkış tarafıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal mülke veya işe giren mali değeri bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir amaçla dışarı çıkarılan malı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı mali hesabın içeri ve dışarı yönlü akışlarını gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sonuçta oluşan mali giriştir; komşu dal bu değeri elde etme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal elde edilmiş değerin içeri giren mali kalem oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal malı kazanma veya kazanca ulaşma eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ekonomik değer ve kazanç alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel mali giriştir; komşu dal özellikle alım satım sonucundaki artışı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kaynağı ne olursa olsun içeri giren kazanç kalemini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal alışveriş ve ticaret sonunda oluşan artışla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ticari artış bir işin gelirine dönüşebildiği için iki alan kesişebilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Develerin ikinci kez su başına götürülmesi veya susuz hayvanların içen sürünün arasına katılması anlatıldığında kullanılmalıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Develeri, su başını, yeniden içirmeyi ve araya katmayı korur.

concept_gloss.text: develeri yeniden ya da araya katarak sulama

concept_map.definition: Develer su içtikten sonra yeniden su başına götürülür veya susuz develer içmekte olanların arasına katılarak ikinci kez içmeleri sağlanır. Bir kaynak anlatımı, sürünün bir kerede sıkışık biçimde suya sürülmesini de aynı düzenin başka bir yüzü sayar.

facets.statement: Su içmiş develer ikinci kez su başına döndürülerek yeniden içirilir.
Susuz develer henüz içmemiş develerin arasına katılır ve onlarla birlikte içmeleri sağlanır.
Başka bir görünümde sürü, aralarında sıkışıklık olacak biçimde bir kerede su başına sürülür.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sürü daha önce içmişken yeniden su başına döndürülüyorsa bu açık karşılık kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Susuz hayvanları başka develerin arasına katma ve tek seferlik sıkışık sulama çeşitlerini kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Develerin yeniden su başına götürülmesi işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İkinci içişin, susuz hayvanların öteki develerin arasına sokulmasıyla sağlandığı durumda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Bütün sürüyü yeniden suya döndürme ve sıkışık biçimde bir kerede sürme çeşitlerini dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Susuz deveyi sürü arasına katma ve içmesini sağlama yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.text: susuz develeri içen sürünün arasına katmak

error_profile.adds: Her hayvanı ve her türlü su verme işlemini kapsar.
error_profile.loses: İkinci kez götürme veya sürünün arasına katma düzenini siler.
error_profile.preserves: Hayvana su içirme amacını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel sulama değil, develerin su başındaki ikinci girişini veya sürüye aradan katılarak içmesini düzenleyen özel işlemdir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi develerin içtikten sonra yeniden su başına götürülmesini temel görünüm olarak verir; ayrıca susuz develeri henüz içmemiş olanların arasına katma ve sürüyü bir kerede sıkışık biçimde sulama çeşitlemelerini de açıkça kaydeder.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: develeri ikinci kez suya götürme veya susuz deveyi sürüye katma

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalın deve sulama düzenini verir ve bu özel hayvancılık anlamını genel içeri girme ya da her türlü sulama anlamına genişletmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: On yedi adayın tamamı değerlendirildi; su başından geçirme, suya doyma ve sırada bekleme ile en açıklayıcı üç sınır seçildi, gün aralığına dayalı sulama adları ve uzak kardeş dallar elendi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın amacı ve sonucu içmedir; komşu dalda temel işlem yalnızca su yalağı boyunca geçirmektir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal develeri ikinci kez içirmek veya susuz deveyi içenlerin arasına katmak için su başına sokar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yeniden içirme ve su başından geçirme
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal develeri su yalağının yanından ya da üzerinden geçirmekle sınırlıdır ve içirme sonucu gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal develerin su yalağı çevresindeki yönlendirilmesini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düzenleme işlemidir; komşu dal ise içmenin tamamlanıp hayvanın suya doyması sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sürünün suya hangi sırayla veya kaçıncı kez sokulduğunu düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal develerin yeterince su içmiş ve susuzluğunu gidermiş olma sonucunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal deve sulama sürecinin farklı yönlerini konu eder.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda araya sokma veya geri döndürme vardır; komşu dalda hayvanlar sıranın açılmasını bekler.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal susuz develerin içenlerin arasına etkin biçimde katılmasını veya yeniden götürülmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal su başındaki içenlerin arkasında bekleyip onların ayrılmasından sonra girecek develeri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bazı develerin su başındaki başka develere göre konumunu ve içme sırasını düzenler.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الدخال في الورد أن تشرب الإبل ثم ترد إلى الحوض (maqayis)؛ سقيت الإبل دخالا إذا حملتها على الحوض ثانية والدخال في وجه آخر أن تحملها على الحوض بمرة واحدة عراكا (ayn)؛ أورد الرجل إبله دخالا (jamhara)؛ الدخال في الورد أن يشرب البعير ثم يرد من العطن إلى الحوض (sihah)؛ الدخال في الإبل أن يدخل إبل في أثناء ما لم تشرب لتشرب معها ثانيا (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, develeri su başına yeniden sokarak içirmeyi merkez alır; susuz hayvanları sürünün arasına katma ile sürüyü bir kerede sıkışık götürme biçimlerini aynı ad altında farklı uygulamalar olarak korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الدخال في الورد: أن ترد الإبل إلى الحوض ثانية أو يدخل بعير عطشان بين بعيرين ليتم شربه، وكذلك إيرادها عراكا في وجه آخر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق الدخول ولا الدخل المالي.

concept_gloss.applicability: Parçalar birbirine geçtiğinde, bir çekirdek çevresinde toplandığında veya iki bölüm arasındaki iç konumu doldurduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İç içe birleşmeyi, çevrede toplanmayı ve ara konumu korur.

concept_gloss.text: iç içe geçme ve arada kalma

concept_map.definition: Parçalar birbirinin arasına girerek birleşir, bir ana bölüm çevresinde toplanır veya iki bölüm arasında yer alır. Bu düzen eklem, et, renk, tüy ve bitki örtüsü gibi farklı maddelerde görülebilir.

facets.statement: Bir parçanın başka parçaların arasına girmesi veya onlarla iç içe birleşmesi temel ilişkidir.
Eklemlerin birbirine geçmesi ve etin bir sinir üzerinde toplanması yapısal örneklerdir.
Bir ana rengin içinde başka renklerin dağınık biçimde bulunması görsel alandaki uzantıdır.
Kuşun sırtıyla karnı arasındaki tüyler ve ağaç kökleri arasına giren ot, ara konum örnekleridir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eklemler veya başka yapısal parçalar birbirinin arasına girerek bağlandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Renk karışımını ve iki bölge arasında bulunan tüy ya da ot örneklerini kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Yapısal iç içe geçme ve birleşme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir ana görünüm içinde başka renkler dağınık biçimde bulunduğunda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Eklemler, et, tüy ve otla ilgili yapısal örnekleri dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Renk parçalarının ana renk içinde yer almasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: bir rengin içine başka renklerin karışması

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tüy veya ot gibi bir parça iki bölgenin arasında ya da başka yapıların kökünde yer aldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Karşılıklı geçme ve renklerin birbirine karışması süreçlerini göstermez.
error_profile.preserves: Parçanın içteki ara konumunu korur.

error_profile.adds: Düzensiz birleşme, bulanma ve toplumsal müdahale gibi ilgisiz anlamları kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel karışıklık veya bir işe müdahale anlamıyla karışır.
error_profile.loses: Birbirinin arasına girme, belirli bir çevrede toplanma ve ara konum ayrımlarını siler.
error_profile.preserves: Renklerin veya parçaların bir arada bulunma yönünü kısmen korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, parçaların birbirine geçmesi veya başka parçaların arasında kalmasıyla sınırlıdır; küçük kuş adı ve örme kap adı ayrı dallardır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eklemlerin birbirine geçmesini, sinir çevresinde toplanan eti, bir renge karışan başka renkleri ve iki bölge arasında veya ağaç köklerinde kalan tüy ile otu ortak bir iç içelik ve ara konum düzeninde toplar.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir sinir üzerinde toplanmış et parçası
bir ana renge karışmış başka renkler

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın iç içelik ve ara konum dalını açıklar; özel kuş ve kap adlarını ya da kalıba bağlı başka kullanımları buraya taşımaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iç yapı ve ara konumu ayrıntılandırır; komşu dal ise iki taraflı karışma ilişkisini örnek sınırı koymadan verir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yapısal geçme, ara konum, renk dağılımı ve belirli maddi örnekleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki tarafın karşılıklı karışmasını genel ve daha soyut biçimde bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın belirleyicisi iç konumdur; komşu dalda buna ek olarak güçlü baskı ve sıkışıklık zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda iç içelik baskı bulunmadan da oluşabilir ve renk, tüy veya ot gibi örneklere uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal parçaların güçlü basınç altında sıkıca birbirine girmesini gerektirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, parçaların iç içe geçmesi ve arada yer alması düzenini eklem, sinir çevresindeki et, renk karışımı, kuş tüyleri ve ağaç köklerindeki ot üzerinden farklı maddi görünümlerle açıklar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مداخلة المفاصل، واللحمة المجتمعة على عصب، والدخلة في اللون، وريش ما بين الظهر والبطن، والكلأ الداخل في أصول الشجر.

concept_gloss.applicability: Adı bilinmeyen genel bir kuş türü gibi değil, kanıtta oyuk ve sık ağaçlık yaşamıyla tanımlanan belirli küçük kuş için kullanılmalıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük kuşu, sık ağaçlık yaşam alanını ve içeri girme bağını korur.

concept_map.definition: Oyuklarda, vadi içlerinde ve sık ağaçların altında barınan belirli bir küçük kuştur. Adı, sık ağaçların arasına girmesiyle açıklanır ve iki ayrı çoğul biçimi vardır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir küçük kuş ve bu kuşun oyuklar ile sık ağaç altlarındaki barınma alanı anlatılır.
Kuş adının, hayvanın sık ağaçların arasına girme davranışından doğduğu açıklanır.
Kuş adının iki farklı çoğul biçimi aktarılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tür adının hedef dilde yerleşik bir karşılığı verilmeden yaşam alanıyla açıklanması gerektiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Adın içeri girme davranışından türetilmesi ve çoğul biçimleri açıklamada görünmez.
error_profile.preserves: Kuşun küçüklüğünü ve oyuklarla sık bitki örtüsündeki yaşamını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: oyuklarda ve çalılıkta yaşayan küçük kuş

error_profile.adds: Kanıtın belirlemediği ayrı bir kuş türü kimliği ekler.
error_profile.collision: Bilinen serçe türleriyle yanlış özdeşlik kurar.
error_profile.loses: Oyuk ve sık ağaçlık yaşam alanını, içeri girme açıklamasını ve özgül adı siler.
error_profile.preserves: Küçük bir kuş olma yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal belirli küçük kuş adıdır; her küçük kuşa, kuşun yaşadığı çalılığa veya örme kaba genellenemez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, oyuklarda, vadi içlerinde ve sık ağaçların altında barınan küçük bir kuş adını verir; adın kuşun sık ağaçların arasına girmesiyle açıklanmasını ve iki çoğul biçimini de kaydeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal küçük oluş, oyuk ve sık ağaçlık yaşamı ile tanımlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: küçük kuş ve güvercine benzeyen kuş
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüksek bölgelerde yaşayan ve güvercine benzeyen başka bir kuşu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da görünüş veya yaşam alanıyla açıklanan kuş adlarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sık ağaçların arasında barınan kuşun kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çok ve birbirine geçmiş ağaçlardan oluşan koruluğu adlandırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, işin ya da şeyin bozukluğun karşıtı olan iyi ve düzgün durumda bulunması veya bu duruma gelmesi; ayrıca bir şeyi bozukluktan arındırarak iyi duruma getirme işlemidir. Belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranma anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir yönelme yapısında anlam, bir hayvana iyi davranmaya kadar uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalın çekirdeğini bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durum olarak kurar; ayrıca bu duruma gelmeyi, bir şeyi bu duruma getirmeyi ve belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranmayı da kapsar. text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

baseline.text: İnanıp iyi işler yapanları mutlaka iyilerin arasına katacağız.

findings.text: İyilerin arasına katılmak yalnız bir yere girmek değil, iyi işlerle uyum kazanmış kişinin nitelik ve topluluk bakımından onlara karışmasıdır.
Önceki ayette gerekli olabilen ilkeli aile karşıtlığının ardından bu katılma, doğru sınır koymanın kişiyi ilişkisiz bırakmayacağını gösteren bir toplumsal onarımdır.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inward commitment that the following work enacts.
Purposeful action turns assent into an operative deed rather than a bare label.
Repair opposed to corruption marks both the deeds and, by repetition, the destination company.
Movement into an inside gives the promise the force of actual admission, not mere resemblance.

changed_reading.after: Belief enacted as repair culminates in God's actual admission of the actors into the company characterized by that repair.
changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive a favorable reward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 2-7 joins belief, intentional work, the repeated ص ل ح quality, and causative entry into a human plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled assent becomes intended action characterized by repair rather than corruption; God then moves the actors inside the company characterized by that same repair.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and aptness span the fitting deeds and the people fitted to the resulting company.
The image of a newcomer mixing with a group sharpens entry as incorporation among people.

changed_reading.after: The repeated quality migrates from deed to actor and becomes durable belonging among people fitted to the same quality.
changed_reading.before: Good deeds qualify their performers for an externally assigned category.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ص ل ح occurs first in the deeds at word 4 and again in the human plural at word 7, across لندخلنهم في.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root carries one quality from outputs to persons, while causative entry converts predication into social placement: what was done becomes the company in which the doers belong.

activation_trace.role: Intended action keeps reconciliation tied to performed deeds rather than an abstract theme.
Removal of estrangement supplies a social-repair sense shared by the deeds and the cohort.
Admission supplies the transition from repairing action into a community of repairers.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are a company constituted by acts that remove estrangement, into which the actors are admitted.
changed_reading.before: The righteous are a generic class of morally good people.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ص ل ح pair at words 4 and 7 can carry the branch of removing estrangement, and في الصالحين makes its second occurrence collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the deeds are acts that remove aversion, admission among the صالحين can mean incorporation among people whose shared practice is relational repair.

activation_trace.role: Assent anchored in the heart is the focus claim whose durability is at issue.
Mixing into a group makes the result of disclosure a changed affiliation.
Assaying a human like material supplies the process that tests whether the claim holds.
Truth realized in promise and action supplies the positive result revealed by the assay.
A shown entrance with a hidden exit models the unstable affiliation contrasted with admitted membership.

changed_reading.after: The emphatic promise ratifies a membership that pressure has made real and distinguishable from verbal or reversible affiliation.
changed_reading.before: Anyone described as believing and doing good is simply counted among the righteous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening tests the spoken claim of belief, exposes fulfilled truth, and later contrasts it with a two-exit posture that changes allegiance under pressure. Entry among the صالحين therefore reads as a divinely disclosed membership after assay, not a self-certified identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, assay, disclosed truth, and unstable affiliation; I infer the arrow from those disclosures to the focus promise's group placement. A live alternative is that entry is only later reward and not the social result of testing.
structural_cues: 29:2-3 encloses the claim آمنا between testing and the disclosure of truthful and lying actors.
29:10-11 repeats the belief claim, depicts pressure-driven realignment, and then distinguishes believers from منافقين.

activation_trace.role: The repeated repair-quality carries restoration from deed into personal and collective status.
Causative admission supplies the additional movement beyond accounting.
Covering that effaces sin supplies remediation of the negative record.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the transactional promise paired with admission.
The better or beautiful measure raises recompense above a bare one-for-one return.

changed_reading.after: Forgiveness and recompense do not exhaust the outcome: the focus adds transformation of status through incorporation among repaired people.
changed_reading.before: Entry among the righteous is another wording for forgiveness or payment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-identical opening in 29:7 promises both erasure of bad effects and recompense by the best measure; 29:9 repeats the actors and deeds but changes the result to admission. The focus promise thus adds reconstitution of the person and their company to repair of the record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel subjects, formulas, and different promised predicates; I infer a movement from repaired record to reconstituted belonging. The alternatives are coordinate promises or stylistic variation without sequence.
structural_cues: 29:7 and 29:9 share the same faith-and-righteous-work opening and emphatic first-person plural futures.
29:7 names record repair and recompense, whereas 29:9 names entry into people.

activation_trace.role: Fitness supplies the criterion that orders deed and company when inherited claims conflict.
Mixing into another company activates the social force of the promise.
Parenthood by birth supplies the strong inherited bond that is retained but bounded.
Assigning partnership to God marks the point at which kin-directed compliance becomes misaligned.
Obedient yielding supplies the relation explicitly refused at that boundary.
Return supplies the final venue in which work and affiliation are disclosed.

changed_reading.after: Entry among them is a God-defined affiliation that can outrank coercive inherited loyalty while preserving rightly ordered care for kin.
changed_reading.before: The صالحين are merely a moral rank added to a person without changing relational belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, goodness toward parents remains binding while obedience stops where parents press for divine partnership; return and disclosure of work follow. The promised entry then supplies a non-genealogical affiliation ordered by fitting action without erasing care for biological kin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded kin relation followed by divine return and then group entry; I infer that the focus reorders belonging around fitting action. The live alternative is a purely individual afterlife reward with no kinship contrast.
structural_cues: 29:8 immediately precedes the focus and moves from parental goodness through coerced partnership to refused obedience.
The same ayah closes with return and notification of works before 29:9 promises entry among a new human plural.

activation_trace.role: Removal of estrangement makes the repeated quality an active practice of social repair.
Group-mixing turns repaired relations into the constitution of a company.
Affection supplies the apparently cohesive bond whose false basis is later exposed.
The connection standing between parties supplies the relational structure that can hold or fail.
Road-severing supplies a concrete social mechanism of broken passage and predation.
Entwined contention supplies the conflict in which repair must operate.
Doing what is better supplies the governing action within dispute rather than mere victory over an opponent.

changed_reading.after: They include work that repairs severed connective relations, so entry among the صالحين is incorporation into a community sustained by reconciliation.
changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are private merits that place similar individuals in one class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idol-based affection and connection collapse into mutual repudiation, the public way is cut, and later tightly wound dispute is constrained by what is better. These scenes activate the focus's reconciliation branch: صالح deeds maintain or restore relations and routes that false fellowship severs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed bonds, blocked routes, and disciplined dispute; I infer that the reconciliation branch of ص ل ح names the counter-practice and that its practitioners form the focus cohort. The alternative is that these are separate ethical examples and صالح remains generic.
structural_cues: 29:25 moves from manufactured affection to reciprocal rejection and cursing.
29:29 joins cutting the road to public wrong, while 29:46 regulates argument by the better mode.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an inside is the focus motion later specified by abode imagery.
The repaired human company remains the direct object of belonging.
The same repaired-person category explicitly located in the afterlife supplies the temporal horizon.
Taking or assigning an abode supplies concrete settlement for the focus's entry.
Stable continuance resistant to ending supplies durability to the admitted state.

changed_reading.after: It is at once enduring fellowship among repaired people and actual eschatological emplacement, with the social and spatial senses mutually sharpening.
changed_reading.before: Entry is an abstract verdict that assigns the label righteous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later surah first places Abraham among the صالحين in the afterlife and then repeats the focus opening before promising an appointed abode and permanence. These echoes specify entry as both moral-social classification and enduring emplacement, without reducing either dimension to the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated formulas, an afterlife occurrence of the cohort, abode, and permanence; I infer that the later promise retrospectively gives the focus entry locative and durable force. A live alternative keeps social admission and garden lodging as independent rewards.
structural_cues: 29:27 uses من الصالحين after contrasting worldly reward with the afterlife.
29:58 repeats الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات and the emphatic promise form, then names lodging and permanence.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work is the focus material whose result must be assessed.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the operative criterion for both deeds and people.
Departure from صلاح and balance supplies the explicit human opposite of the focus cohort.
Corrupting action in the land scales the opposite quality from persons to public effects.
Making something appear good supplies the deceptive surface that cannot certify a work as صالح.
Turning others away supplies the contrary effect produced by those beautified works.

changed_reading.after: The adjective demands operative repair: deeds belong here when they resist corruption and preserve right passage, not when they only look good to their performers.
changed_reading.before: Any well-intended or attractive work may count as one of the صالحات.

context_deltas.mechanism: Corruptors are named by departure from صلاح and balance, while apparently beautified works can still turn people from the road. The surah therefore supplies an effects test for the focus adjective: صالح action repairs or maintains order and passage rather than merely appearing admirable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical opposite and a mismatch between attractive works and blocked passage; I infer consequences as a diagnostic arrow for صالح. The alternative treats صالح and فساد as conventional moral labels without this functional test.
structural_cues: 29:30 and 29:36 label people and public conduct by the explicit opposite of صلاح.
29:38 joins beautified أعمال to obstruction from the path even while their performers are perceptive.

remaining_uncertainties: Whether في الصالحين foregrounds present affiliation, eschatological classification, or both remains open.
The reconciliation, habitation, and sanctuary readings are branch-led analogies and should not replace the ordinary moral sense.
The parallel promises support but do not require a strict temporal order from pardon to reconstitution to lodging.
strongest_changes: Membership is assayed and disclosed rather than established by saying that one believes.
The promise reorders affiliation across kin pressure and adds reconstituted belonging to pardon and recompense.
Later lodging and permanence make entry both communal and eschatological, while corruption and blocked-path scenes provide an effects test for صالح work.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah recurrence turns the compact promise into a hinge between tested identity, reordered belonging, social repair, and durable emplacement; the spider-house and secure-sanctuary scenes also activate contained spatial analogies.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an inside allows a human company to be read with restrained habitation imagery.
Reconciliation supplies the relational strength of the company entered.
Protective affection and alliance supply the social relation falsely sought in other patrons.
Dwelling and shelter supply the alternative container image against which human belonging can be read.
Loss of strength marks the failure of a shelter built from misdirected alliance.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is entry into a relational habitation whose repaired bonds contrast with the weakest shelter made by false patronage.
changed_reading.before: Among the righteous denotes only placement on a list of people.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a human cohort through the later spider-house image. It remains anchored in the focus's entry preposition, the group-mixing branch of د خ ل, and the reconciliation branch of ص ل ح, while 29:41 supplies patrons, dwelling, and weakness. Render it only as a relational-spatial analogy, not as an equation of the صالحين with a literal house.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لندخلنهم في الصالحين at words 5-7 permits the people entered among to function imaginatively as a lived relational inside.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust provide the inward side of the focus's belief.
Causative movement inside supports a bounded-space analogy.
Fitness supplies the quality by which the admitted company coheres.
A protected spatial precinct supplies the outer image for contained belonging.
The shared root joins secure space and believing response within one context occurrence.
Rapid seizure outside supplies the threat against which secure belonging is perceived.
The surrounding region supplies the boundary contrast between precinct and exposure.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise images admission into a secure moral precinct of fitted people amid unstable allegiances and surrounding exposure.
changed_reading.before: Belief and entry among the righteous are abstract inward and classificatory events.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading transfers the secure precinct of 29:67 to a social-moral company, so it is intentionally unusual. It remains anchored by the focus's ء م ن, causative entry, fitness branch, and the later ayah's deliberate recurrence of ء م ن for both security and belief amid snatching around. Render it as a spatial activation of belonging, not a claim that الصالحين lexically means sanctuary or guarantees worldly immunity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins heart-security at word 2 to entry at word 5 into a company fitted at words 4 and 7.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Entry as incorporation into a people.** د خ ل B005 is “an entrant mixed into a group or affair,” beyond B001's simple going in. The same صالح root names both deeds and the destination-group. I infer that repeated right action makes the entrant congruent with the company entered; the promise reads as social and qualitative incorporation, not only admission to a location.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:58's prepared settlement gives the earlier social entry a spatial counterpart. The surah moves from being mixed among the صالحين to being settled in an abode fitted to صالح action.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sound acts culminate in social incorporation.** Lexical evidence: `ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ / ٱلصَّالِحِينَ`, root `ص ل ح`, `B001` (soundness and rightness against corruption), and `لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ`, root `د خ ل`, `B005` (an entrant mixed into a group or affair), alongside literal entry `B001`. Structural cue: the object is not a place but the plural class `الصالحين`; `29:10-12` immediately show unstable affiliation, hypocrisy, and an invitation to follow another way. Assigned role: sound work fits the agent for mixture into a sound community. Abductive move: the packet supplies work followed by group-entry; I infer that enacted soundness is the basis of incorporation rather than verbal self-placement. Reading change: the promise is communal reclassification, not merely movement into a location.

2. **The ayah repairs the isolation risk created by bounded family obedience.** Lexical evidence: `د خ ل B001/B005` supplies entry and admixture, while `ص ل ح B002` accepts reconciliation and settlement between people as a dormant branch. Structural cue: `29:8` may require refusal of parents; `29:9` answers immediately with entry among the sound, before `29:10-11` distinguish unstable and divided belonging. Assigned role: the sound group supplies a replacement field of relation without erasing the prior command of goodness. Abductive move: the packet does not state that refusal causes new membership; I infer a contextual repair: principled separation need not end in social abandonment. Reading change: entry among the sound reads as relational restoration as well as reward.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:27`, `29:58`):** Abraham is explicitly placed among the sound in the later horizon, and faithful workers are settled into prepared chambers. These later realizations expand `د خ ل B005`: incorporation among the sound develops into durable lineage, status, and inhabitable belonging.

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that keeps the ayah connected to the prior warning while launching a fresh reward declaration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens 29:9 as a connected reset: it moves away from the prior consequence chain while still tying the reward statement to the trial-and-warning movement before it. Because it fuses directly to the relative pronoun, the connector is not a detached transition; it launches the recognizable believer-and-deeds formula as the ayah's new frame. The particle can hold coordination, resumption, and a circumstantial shade together, so the reader hears both continuity with 29:8 and the beginning of a complete promise clause. It also stands at the first edge of the ayah's emphatic architecture: the explicit oath-like force is carried later by the promise particle and heavy nūn, while the opening connector keeps that sworn promise attached to the prior scene.

topics.headline: connected reset after the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 29:9 is neither a clean break nor a mere continuation, but a reward declaration reset through a connector.
topics.reason: The opening particle precedes a syntactically complete relative-and-promise unit, while the boundary rows connect it to 29:8.

topics.headline: formulaic believer-class launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening connector fused to the relative class marker, making the reward formula begin as one joined launch.
topics.reason: The particle is attached to the relative pronoun and the bundle marks the believer formula as a repeat anchored at 29:7.

topics.headline: opening within emphatic architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the opening as part of a larger emphatic architecture, while the explicit oath force is carried later by the promise verb.
topics.reason: The later emphatic particle and energetic verb license an ayah-level emphatic frame, but the first word itself remains a conjunction.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun that identifies the promised class through the following faith-and-action clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the promised recipients a class defined by what follows, not a named group introduced from outside the ayah. The pronoun remains incomplete until the faith verb and the work verb fill its relative clause, so belief and action jointly define the topic before the divine guarantee arrives. Its definiteness can point back to the local formula at 29:7 while still leaving the class open to anyone who meets the stated criterion, and its sustained long ī gives the class marker audible weight before the first qualifying verb begins.

topics.headline: class identified by the relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient class is built from the two following actions rather than supplied as an external label.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes words 2-6 the relative qualification, with the two coordinated verbs filling the pronoun's content.

topics.headline: topic before delayed predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah define the recipients first and only then answer them with the sworn promise.
topics.reason: The promise clause is predicated of the relative topic after the qualification beat is complete.

topics.headline: definite form with open criterion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a known local formula from 29:7 while the relative construction still defines the group by criterion, with the long ending giving the class marker audible weight.
topics.reason: The bundle marks a repeated formula anchored at 29:7, and the local relative pronoun remains criterion-based.

words.gloss_range: perfective Form IV plural faith verb, locally objectless and class-defining, carrying trust-commitment rather than bare assent alone
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) supplies the first qualifying action of the relative class. Its perfective plural form makes faith an established qualification, and its lack of an expressed object lets trust-commitment define the group before the deed object appears. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) family keeps security, trustworthiness, and covenantal reliability in view, while local Form IV and the objectless frame keep the sense at committed faith rather than making the subjects securing agents. Because this verb is paired with the work verb and the sound-deeds object, the ayah does not let faith stand alone; it opens the formula also visible in reward passages (2:25; 4:57; 18:30) and repeated at 29:7 before this ayah specializes the reward as admission among the sound ones. The move from the faith verb to the work verb also has an audible inner-to-outer turn, from glottal onset toward pharyngeal onset, and after 29:8's disclosure warning the trust verb names the responding class.
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, belief, reliability, and covenantal safety field; local Form IV selects believing or committing in trust, not causing others to be safe

topics.headline: established objectless faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith presented as an established class-defining commitment, not as a command or a belief statement with an explicit object.
topics.reason: The verb is perfective 3mp and the local frame is objectless, matching the class-defining relative clause.

topics.headline: trust and security field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears faith as trust-aligned commitment within the security field, while local grammar prevents turning the believers into agents who secure others.
topics.reason: The wider root family supplies trust and safety pressure, but the surface Form IV verb here functions as objectless believing or trust-commitment.

topics.headline: plural agreement carries the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the masculine plural relative class inside the verb ending, keeping the promise recipients collective.
topics.reason: The verb's 3mp agreement is tied by attachment evidence to the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: faith opens the reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that this faith verb expects the action-and-soundness partner, belongs to a wider reward formula (2:25; 4:57; 18:30), and repeats the 29:7 formula with a new reward outcome.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence profiles and CRITICAL echo rows support the faith-action-soundness formula, including the explicit 29:7 reprise.

topics.headline: first slot of the qualification pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from trust to performed work before the admission promise answers the completed pair, with the sound shift and 29:8 disclosure boundary sharpening that turn.
topics.reason: The verb opens the coordinated qualification pair and is followed by the action verb before the promise clause.

words.gloss_range: inner conjunction coordinating the work verb with the faith verb under the same relative class
words.prose: The inner {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the work verb to the faith verb under the same relative pronoun. It is simple coordination on the surface, but in this formula it also makes the two actions co-requisites: the class is not defined by faith in isolation or by work as a separate aside. Its fused written and recited shape makes the movement from trust to labor continuous without subordinating either verb.

topics.headline: second verb under the same relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief and work as coordinated qualifications of one class, not as separate groups or clauses.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence directly coordinates the work verb with the faith verb inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: hinge from faith to work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the formula's hinge from inner commitment to performed work, with neither member allowed to replace the other.
topics.reason: The particle is fused to the second verb and the collocation profile confirms the strong faith-work pairing.

topics.headline: audible binding into the work verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector is heard as joined to the work verb, reinforcing the paired movement.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a real but secondary payoff to the same coordinated hinge.

words.gloss_range: perfective Form I plural work verb taking the definite sound-deeds object and completing the relative qualification
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) completes the relative qualification begun by the faith verb. It shares the same plural class and perfective aspect, presenting the deeds as already actualized qualifications, but unlike the faith verb it takes the explicit sound-deeds object, so the qualification moves from trust-commitment into performed, object-directed work. The {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) field points to productive action rather than vague doing, while local Form I keeps the work direct and uncaused. This makes the faith-work pair the formulaic trigger before the ayah's divine admission promise, separating human production in the first beat from divine admission in the second.
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, producing, and deliberate practiced action; local Form I selects direct performed work with an explicit object

topics.headline: work takes the sound-deeds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is not left generic; it is directed toward the definite category of sound deeds.
topics.reason: The bundle marks the sound-deeds noun as the direct object of the work verb.

topics.headline: same class, completed action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same plural relative class through a second perfective qualification rather than hearing a new subject.
topics.reason: The verb carries 3mp agreement and is coordinated with the first verb under the same relative head.

topics.headline: productive work, not vague doing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears work as deliberate productive action, while local Form I keeps it a direct act rather than an employment or seeking frame.
topics.reason: The derivative and branch rows color the action field, but the local form is simple Form I with an explicit object.

topics.headline: faith-work formula completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second verb complete the familiar reward-trigger formula before the promise arrives.
topics.reason: The profiles show strong work-soundness pairing and the local clause repeats the belief-and-deeds formula.

topics.headline: human work before divine admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completed human work is stated before the ayah shifts to God's caused admission.
topics.reason: The first clause defines human qualifications, and the second clause supplies the divine promise.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active-participle noun functioning as the object of the work verb: the known category of sound deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the explicit object of the work verb, so the ayah names not just work but work directed to a known category of sound deeds. Its active-participle shape describes deeds by their quality of soundness and fitness, while the {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) family keeps repair and communal benefit in the background without replacing the local object function. The feminine sound plural gathers the deeds as a category and carries the object relation with a kasra-shaped ending; its assimilated article and emphatic onset audibly fuse definiteness to the soundness root. The feminine plural deed-form later answers to the masculine plural people-form at the close, so the ayah's own root echo moves from sound deeds to sound company.
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, fitness, repair, reconciliation, and proper functioning; local noun selects qualified deeds, not an abstract state alone

topics.headline: known category of deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the work verb lands on a definite recognized category, not on an unspecified good act.
topics.reason: The noun is the forced direct object of the work verb and is marked definite.

topics.headline: soundness and repair pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the deeds as characterized by soundness, fitness, and repair pressure, while local syntax keeps them as the object being done.
topics.reason: The participial noun supports an evaluative deed category; broader repair and benefit branches color the field but do not turn the word into an abstract noun.

topics.headline: feminine plural deed category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the form gather deeds as a category and prepare the contrast with the later masculine plural people noun.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as feminine plural active participle, and the ayah later repeats the same root in a masculine people plural.

topics.headline: sound deeds answer as sound company
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local root loop: sound deeds in the qualification become sound people at the destination.
topics.reason: The same root appears in word 6 and word 10, with word 6 as deed-object and word 10 as destination group.

topics.headline: assimilated soundness onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that definiteness and the soundness root are audibly compressed at the emphatic onset.
topics.reason: The sound rows preserve a secondary but concrete surface payoff in the noun's article assimilation and emphatic onset.

words.gloss_range: emphatic oath or answer lām prefixed to the admission verb, marking the pivot into the sworn promise
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) marks the turn from the qualified class to the promise itself. It is not a preposition governing a following noun; it fuses onto the verb and works with the heavy energetic ending to make the admission clause emphatic and oath-like. The short particle launches the heavier cadence of the promise verb, so it becomes the hinge where the first beat of faith and deeds gives way to the second beat of sworn divine action.

topics.headline: emphatic marker on the promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the promise as emphatically secured rather than as a weak future possibility.
topics.reason: QAC identifies emphatic lām, and the attachment support flags preservation of emphatic force with the heavy nūn.

topics.headline: answer marker, not governor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids reading the particle as a preposition and instead sees it as verbal-clause emphasis.
